Job Title: Business Analyst

Department: FRS

About Business line/Function: SDE

Position Purpose

To ensure that the candidate performs the Business analysis and requirements on accounting application and has worked on General Ledger system with proven experience and good working knowledge of CIB’s core businesses and financial systems.

Experience: 3 – 7 years of experience

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

• Analyzing user requirements and business processes,
• Liaising with users and internal counterparts from Finance, IT and Operations in Montreal, New Jersey and Mumbai
• Liaising with end-users for requirements gathering, UAT and migration testing up to successful delivery of the expected solution
• Developing functional specifications for delivery to IT,
• Ensuring IT developments are in line with the functional specifications,
• Performing integration testing and User Acceptance Testing,
• Ensuring on-time quality delivery of all activities assigned

Contributing Responsibilities

• Providing users with Subject Matter expertise for finance systems.
• Contribute towards the Quarter and Month end support queries.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies

• Good knowledge of accounting concepts, General Ledger and Capital Market Good understanding of the products used by an Investment Bank Foreign, Interest Rates derivatives, securities, Repos, Credit derivatives
• Comfortable with basic office tools (Teams, MS Word, Outlook)
• Excellent knowledge and use of Microsoft skills (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, Visio, Project)
• Excellent knowledge and use of Microsoft skills (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint, Visio, Project).

Specific Qualifications

MBA in Finance, Bachelor of Commerce, master’s in commerce, bachelor’s in science, Chartered Accountant

Technical Skills

Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)

• Analytical Ability.
• Ability to understand, explain and support change.
• Knowledge is SQL, Power Bi and Power Query.

Behavioral Skills

• Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving
• Ability to deliver / Results driven
• Communication skills - oral & written
• Attention to detail / rigor

Education Level: Master’s degree or equivalent

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the role
Key Responsibilities
• 
Executive Engagement: Act as a peer to CTOs and VP-level engineering leaders to navigate the evolving AI landscape. 
• 
Solution Direction: Partner with Field Engineers to design enterprise-wide AI adoption strategies, framing problems without getting bogged down in hands-on implementation. 
• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the voice of the customer externally, feeding high-level insights and challenges back into SpaceXAI's internal product and go-to-market teams. 
• 
Technical Strategy: Lead architectural conversations around evaluating Cursor at a systems level, tailoring narratives to different customer technology stacks. 
 
Requirements & Background
• 
Leadership Experience: Usually requires prior experience as an engineering leader, principal architect, or platform leader in complex organizations.
• 
Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of modern engineering organization structures, developer productivity challenges, and AI/LLM tooling. 
• 
Communication Skills: Exceptional external-facing executive presence, with the ability to connect technical capabilities directly to business and organizational impact. 
• 
Startup Mentality: SpaceXAI emphasizes a flat, talent-dense organization. Ideal candidates are truth-seeking, creative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced setting.
